y_train = train_df[target_col]

}

    val_set = lgb.Dataset(val_X, label=val_y, reference=train_set)

    # Train model
    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_set,
        num_boost_round=params["n_estimators"],
        valid_sets=[val_set],
        callbacks=[

        ],  # Early stopping logic simulation or simple loop
    )

# Validate metrics

    model.predict(val_set, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
